hidden.metadata.instruments: The instruments used, derived from the questions' bank sources at publish (question-bank.md lead decision 1); never edited by hand.
hidden.settings.retention: Chosen in Survey settings (options from /api/meta/retention); publishing is refused until it is set.
hidden.consent: Edited in Survey settings (Consent section, the set_consent op): text per language, button labels, decline counting.
hidden.settings.endings: Edited in Survey settings (Endings section, the set_ending op) and from an End node's card: title, body, status line and redirect per outcome.
hidden.settings.redirectTemplates: Edited in Survey settings (Endings section, the set_redirect_template op): the https templates an ending's redirect may use.
hidden.settings.theme: Set in the Appearance view (Use for this survey); a full copy of the theme.
hidden.hooks: Edited in Survey settings (Researcher hooks section, the set_hooks op): the script, the handled events and what each reads; redirects and parent messages in the JSON view.
hidden.specVersion: Format version, written by the platform.
hidden.id: Stable survey identity, assigned at creation.
hidden.version: Published version number, set by publishing.
hidden.metadata.languages: Edited in Survey settings and the translation grid (the set_languages op).
hidden.metadata.ddi: Free-form DDI study metadata; edited in the JSON view.
hidden.choiceLists: Shared lists are edited in the choice list editor.
hidden.variables: Edited in the flow editor and variables view.
